issue.title: Decide whether to add the deferred stats durable-source decision record

task_type_fields.path: decisions/stats-durable-sources.md (new strand in the decisions web)
task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Add a decisions-web strand (for example `decisions/stats-durable-sources.md`) recording,
per plan:202610/sase_stats_project.md §20 "Decision record":

- statistics count each fact at its durable source: git history for commits, the plan
  store for plans, the run index only for runs;
- every `sase stats` header names its machine when a section reads local stores;
- commit footers stamp only provenance that cannot be derived elsewhere (`SASE_MODEL`,
  unlike the removed `SASE_MACHINE`).

Give the alternatives considered, the cost, and the reopen condition, then run
`sase memory init`.

Why this is a task: epic sase-1m3's auto decision `stats_decision_record = no` was made
with no human review ("final · no human reviewed this plan"), and the plan says to
record the skipped memory change as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP in that case. Every sase-1m3
phase (.1–.12) did so. A human should decide at triage whether to add the record or
cancel this task; closing requires explicit user permission plus `sase memory init`.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1m3 auto-decided stats_decision_record=no without human review, so all twelve phases recorded the skipped decisions-web record as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP for a human to decide.
